name: ProductCard
description:
A product card: a photo with a discount badge and a wishlist toggle, the name, price and original price, and whatever the block adds (sizes, quantity, the cart button) - composed from Badge, Toggle, Button, ToggleGroup and NumberField.

  ProductCard(name: product.name, description: product.subtitle, image: product.photo_url,
    price: product.price, original_price: product.list_price, action: cart_items_path) do
    ProductOptions(sizes: product.sizes, selected: "42")
    ProductAddToCart()
  end

With `action:` the card is a form: the size group submits `size`, the quantity `quantity` and the hidden `product_id:` - Add to cart posts them. Strings: product_card.locales.yml.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes Blocks (e.g. `ProductCard(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

ProductAddToCart.description: The ProductCard's full-width Add to cart button, pinned to the bottom of the card. In a card with `action:` it submits the form.

ProductOptions.description:
The ProductCard's option row: a size picker (a ToggleGroup of outline toggles) and a quantity NumberField. In a card with `action:` they submit `size` and `quantity`.

  ProductOptions(sizes: %w[ 40 41 42 43 ], selected: "42", max: 9)

examples.name: Usage
examples.notes: The Appica homepage card. The discount badge is computed from the two prices.
examples.code:
phlex do
  ProductCard(price:, original_price:, currency:, wishlisted:, wishlist:, method:, name:, description:, image:, image_alt:, class: "w-95 max-w-full") do
    ProductOptions(sizes: %w[ 40 41 42 43 ], selected: "42")
    ProductAddToCart()
  end
end

examples.name: Add to cart form
examples.notes: With `action:` the card is a form posting `product_id`, `size` and `quantity`.
examples.code:
phlex do
  ProductCard(name: "Nimbus Runner", description: "Men's running shoes", image: "/landing/nimbus-runner.svg",
    price: 96, original_price: 120, action: "/cart_items", product_id: 42, class: "w-95 max-w-full") do
    ProductOptions(sizes: %w[ 40 41 42 43 ], selected: "42")
    ProductAddToCart()
  end
end

examples.name: Full price, no photo
examples.notes: No original price means no badge; a missing image shows a placeholder.
examples.code:
phlex do
  ProductCard(name: "Trail Cap", description: "Unisex, one size", price: 28, wishlist: false, class: "w-95 max-w-full") do
    ProductOptions(quantity: 2)
    ProductAddToCart()
  end
end

examples.name: RTL
examples.notes: Rendered in Arabic whatever the toolbar says.
examples.code:
phlex do
  I18n.with_locale(:ar) do
    div(dir: "rtl") do
      ProductCard(name: "نيمبوس رانر", description: "أحذية جري رجالية", image: "/landing/nimbus-runner.svg",
        price: 96, original_price: 120, class: "w-95 max-w-full") do
        ProductOptions(sizes: %w[ 40 41 42 43 ], selected: "42")
        ProductAddToCart()
      end
    end
  end
end
